'''Bryint''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during which he was stationed on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bryint appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2011]], as the Ord Mantell Commendations Vendor on Carrick Station, though with the retirement of the planetary commendation system Bryint was relabeled as a Level 8 Equipment Vendor. He was removed along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
